name: character-casting-studio
title_zh: 把角色设定铸成可交付的真人选角卡
tagline_zh: 从一句人设到商业级选角素材：正面、侧面、多套服装一次出齐。材质参考驱动，光影统一，像真拍了三视图。
tagline_en: From one-line persona to a commercial-grade casting sheet: front, side, and multiple outfits in one pass.
desc_en: Create original, material-reference-driven, consistent, photorealistic character casting sheets for commercial, advertising, cinematic, model, occupational, everyday, historical, traditional-cultural, literary, or lightly fantastical character concepts. why_zh: 不靠提示词碰运气，而是用材质参考锁定皮肤、布料、金属的反射特性，让三视图的光影和肤色跨图不漂移。
why_en: No prompt roulette. It locks reflectance via material references, so skin, fabric, and metal stay consistent across views—no.
limit_zh: 只产出单张含正面、侧面的选角图，不生成多视角独立文件；人物必须是人形，非人、机械、怪物类设定直接失效。
limit_en: Outputs a single sheet with front/side views only—no separate multi-angle files. Humanoid only; non-human, mech, or monster concepts fail. Needs.
